operating_point.platform: CPU (CI's default lane; the laptop for the local runs)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the default band (2h, 0.3h), interior 0.1h; the FVM's default tolerance per dtype; Stokes gates steady and flux-free; the Re 76 gate R3's case (a sphere of radius 0.1875 D on a periodic tube's axis, D/h 16, 3 cells a radius, 4 D long, G = 8 nu U/R^2, IMEX Euler at CFL 0.4, 200 steps); water-like mu 1e-3, rho 1000

gate_1_re0_ladder.claim: the penalty sphere's Stokes drag approaches Haberman and Sayre and Drag.MRS's as N grows, its effective radius smaller by a shift in cells that falls with N (the shape-and-position form)
gate_1_re0_ladder.case: tests/flow/test_resolved_bodies.py, the steady node, a/R 0.375 at 3 and 6 cells a radius

prediction.why: the band shrinks the body by a constant in cells plus a curvature share falling with N

gate_1_re0_ladder.metric: K = R_zz / (6 pi mu a) with the share, against Haberman and Sayre

control.plant: the band's depth doubled in the body's lift only (a shift the gate must see)

gate_1_re0_ladder.if_wrong: the share or the flux-free superposition is wrong (the first step's probe arm sphere0375 is the cross-check)
gate_1_re0_ladder.cannot_discriminate_if: the planted shift is under the ladder's spread

gate_2_density_ratios_lagged.claim: lagged, with the load the penalty's plus the interior's momentum change, a sphere at Re 76 is stable and smooth at density ratios 0.3 and 1.4 (the measured range's edges); the rigid-interior shortcut diverges at 1.2
gate_2_density_ratios_lagged.case: R3's case through the experiment (built.run, 200 steps)

prediction.why: the field formulation's interior momentum carries the displaced fluid's inertia, so the lagged loop's gain stays under one

gate_2_density_ratios_lagged.metric: the body's axial velocity history: finite, under twice the flow's largest speed, and the step-to-step change of its acceleration changing sign at most twice after the first 10 steps

control.plant: the rigid-interior shortcut: the interior's momentum change taken as m_f (V^n - V^n-1)/dt (the interior moving with the body)

gate_2_density_ratios_lagged.if_wrong: the lagged range is narrower through MIME's node than R3's: the refusal's line moves to what is measured
gate_2_density_ratios_lagged.cannot_discriminate_if: the run is too short for a growth of 1.6 a step to show (200 steps is ample)

gate_3_displaced_share.claim: the displaced share's two controls: a neutral sphere in a free box driven by a uniform force accelerates with the fluid; in a closed box with the fluid's weight as a drive and Gravity attached, a neutral sphere stays at rest
gate_3_displaced_share.case: the node in a free 24^3 box stepped with a rigid body by hand; the experiment in a tube with its drive across the axis

prediction.basis: measured-before (the free box, the builder's smoke) and derived (the closed box: the share cancels the field's buoyancy-like push exactly at steady state)
prediction.why: the drive acts on the fluid alone, so the share restores what the body displaces

gate_3_displaced_share.metric: the body's acceleration over the run's second half against g; the closed box's body speed against the speed it reaches with the share off
gate_3_displaced_share.if_wrong: the share's volume (the hull's, not the indicator's) or its point is wrong
gate_3_displaced_share.cannot_discriminate_if: the drive is too small for the drift to clear the solve's tolerance

gate_3b_closed_box_held.written: 2026-11-11, an amendment committed before its test ran: gate 3's second control (a neutral sphere in a closed box at rest under a drive) was not built with the first; it is built now in the form below, the moving closed-box run replaced by the held body's steady load
gate_3b_closed_box_held.claim: a neutral sphere held at rest in the tube (6 cells a radius, a/R 0.375, the steady Stokes step) under a drive across the axis, which the wall stops: its field load (the push of the pressure the drive builds) and its displaced share cancel
gate_3b_closed_box_held.case: tests/flow/test_resolved_bodies.py, the held sphere's steady step with the drive along x

prediction.why: the share takes the hull's exact volume and the field's push the lifted indicator's, a body a few hundredths of a cell smaller (gate 1's shift), plus the band's recirculation

gate_3b_closed_box_held.metric: |load + share| along the drive over rho V f; the lateral components over the same
gate_3b_closed_box_held.if_wrong: the share and the field's push do not cancel: the drive's pressure is counted twice or not at all on a body in a closed vessel
gate_3b_closed_box_held.cannot_discriminate_if: the drive is along the axis (the periodic flow carries it and no pressure builds)

gate_4_ledger.claim: metered, every receiver's books close at every step; the drag's penalty is booked under its id on the fluid's and the body's rows, its share under its own part, and its sign judged at one velocity by its host, no gift step
gate_4_ledger.case: a sphere carried in a driven tube, metered (ledger_closes)

prediction.basis: derived: the law's power at one velocity is minus its relative dissipation, a sum of squares
prediction.why: the penalty load and its work on the fluid are paired at the twist the field was solved at

gate_4_ledger.metric: ledger_closes; the drag's gift steps on both rows

control.plant: an energy gift, +0.5 times the penalty's load along the twist added to the delivered load

gate_4_ledger.if_wrong: the hosted law's split or its judgement is wrong
gate_4_ledger.cannot_discriminate_if: the body is at rest (no power to judge)

gate_5_ripple.claim: the force of a sphere moved through a cell at the default N varies within a stated line (the moving-body ripple, a quality line the derivatives in position carry)
gate_5_ripple.case: the steady node, a sphere of 6 cells a radius at 8 sub-cell offsets along the axis and across it

prediction.basis: guess: the static wall's geometry-derivative ripple is +-20 % within a cell at D/h 8 to 16 and +-10 % at 32 (a derivative); the force itself much smaller
prediction.why: the smooth band makes the force smooth in the sub-cell position, its derivative less so

gate_5_ripple.metric: (max - min)/mean of the drag over the offsets; the lateral force's derivative in the lateral position over its mean slope

control.plant: a stiff band (the depth a tenth) in the body's lift

gate_5_ripple.if_wrong: the line is set where it is measured
gate_5_ripple.cannot_discriminate_if: the offsets sample one point of the cell

gate_6_position_derivative.claim: a derivative in the body's position through the step equals a central difference within the ripple's line
gate_6_position_derivative.case: jax.grad of the steady lateral force in the lateral offset of a sphere off the axis, against a central difference

prediction.why: the window's corner is held out of the derivative and the band is smooth

control.plant: stop_gradient on the body's position in the lift

gate_6_position_derivative.if_wrong: the window's corner leaks a jump into the derivative
gate_6_position_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: the step is past the ripple's cell

gate_7_float32.claim: the steady penalty drag in float32 is within 1e-3 of float64's (B10's line)
gate_7_float32.case: the steady node at 6 cells a radius

prediction.basis: measured-before (the coupling spike: the penalty's drag 4e-4 to 9e-4 in float32)
prediction.why: the solve's float32 tolerance 1e-5 and the stiff interior's contrast

gate_7_float32.if_wrong: float32's line in the validity text moves to what is measured
gate_7_float32.cannot_discriminate_if: both dtypes stop at the same stall

outcomes.gate_1_re0_ladder: held: K -6.0 % at 3 cells a radius, -0.83 % at 6 (both in their bands; predicted -6.9 %, -1.0 %); the radius 0.071 and 0.019 cells smaller. Control 5/5, clean 0/5; the oracle catches the depth from x1.10 (x1.05 refined), the plant x2 about ten times that
outcomes.gate_2_density_ratios_lagged: held: stable and smooth at 0.3 and 1.4 in both dtypes (longest alternating runs 2 and 0 steps, in [0, 2]); the shortcut at 1.2 non-finite (its growth not read: the run goes NaN). Control: the shortcut planted at the range's edges caught 5/5 at 0.3 in each dtype, clean 0/5; 0/5 at 1.4, where the shortcut is stable, so the 1.4 arm cannot discriminate it (the expected rate was stated at 1.2, which its own test holds). Superseded in PR 259's fix round (tests/flow/predictions_f4_fix.json, gate_2_at_n6 and gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest): the refuting review found the lagged loop's edge is in dt over the body's relaxation times, not in the density ratio alone (it diverged inside 0.3 to 1.4 at larger steps, and at the default N = 6 this metric read a decaying start-up ring at ratio 0.3 as unstable); the edge is measured at rest by energy, the gate re-measured at N = 6 as an acceptance, and the refusal judges dt/tau at the run's N and ratio
outcomes.gate_3_displaced_share: held: the free box's acceleration within 4.1e-4 (float64) and 3.1e-4 (float32) of the drive's (predicted 1e-3). Control 10/10 in each dtype, clean 0/10; the oracle resolves 0.18 to 0.21 of the share, the plant (the whole share) about five times that. The closed box (rest_speed_over_drift) was not built with the gate: see gate_3b
outcomes.gate_3b_closed_box_held: held: the net load 0.037 of rho V g along the drive (predicted 0.02, band [0, 0.1]), 1e-7 across; the field's push -0.963, the share 1.000, both dtypes. Control (the share left out) 0.963 against the line 0.1 in both dtypes: a deterministic case, by hand
outcomes.gate_4_ledger: held clean: every receiver's books close, 0 gift steps on both rows, both dtypes. The control as committed MISSED: a gift added to the delivered load and mirrored into the booked penalty was caught 0/5 in each dtype and at no size up to 0.5 (run 43076141802), because the host judges the law at one velocity from the field, which that plant left alone, and the lagged exchange's unpaired work is the drag rows' by design. Amended before it ran: the body's penalty load at half the twist the field was solved at, caught 5/5 in each dtype, clean 0/5; the oracle resolves a load at 1 - 0.0014 to 1 - 0.003 of the twist (predicted 0.01, band [1e-4, 0.2]). The gate reads the gift count before the stop a gift causes (27 gift steps before a CFL stop at step 29, by hand)

outcomes.gate_6_position_derivative: held: autodiff -0.0053167 against a central difference of a hundredth of a cell -0.0053149, 3.4e-4 apart (predicted 1e-2). Control 3/3, clean 0/3
